title: Jerry Seinfeld at the Iridium
summary: Seinfeld showed up at the Iridium one night when Bucky Pizzarelli filled in for Les.

blocks.x: There’s a nice picture here off of your website with Jerry Seinfeld.

Oh that was at the Iridium. He showed up one night. And Bucky was on that night in fact. Les didn’t feel good and I called Bucky and Jerry came in and we got together. He was very nice, a very nice man.
